content: eas.json build profiles: development (developmentClient:true, dev build required for Nitro/native libs), preview (distribution internal, .apk/.ipa shareable), production (distribution store). extends inheritance not per-platform. env object only for commit-safe values; secrets go to EAS server-side environment variables selected via environment field (development/preview/production). developmentClient implies gradleCommand assembleDebug / Debug buildConfiguration; explicit values win. resourceClass large unavailable on free plan. channel has no effect for dev clients. Test vs prod AdMob IDs and IAP products should switch per profile via app.config dynamic env.
